question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Option 4"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct word to be substituted in the blank (3) is **"where"**.
 
• Here, the adverb** "where"** is used to indicate a location or place.
 
• In the context of the passage, **"where"** is used because it refers to the location where organizations are making modifications.
 
• Hence, **"where"** should be used in the given sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is** "Option 4"**.

**Complete Sentence**: *The service industry in India is growing 1** rapidly __**Increasing customer expectations have forced organisations in the industry to 2**__ introduce __**service innovations and explore ways to improve revenues and profitability. The hotel industry is a good example of the service business 3**__ where __**organisations are modifying their service delivery 4._______ to attract greater number of customers. The newly emerging micro-stay segment is 5._______ space for itself in the hotel industry.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Whom**: It is an object pronoun used to refer to the object of a verb or preposition.
 
• **Which**: It is a relative pronoun used to introduce a clause that provides additional information about a noun or pronoun.
 
• **When**: It is an adverb or conjunction used to refer to a specific time or period.
